system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 3 hours, 10 Spell Uses. Lasts: 1 hour. Lets a target understand ciphers, old languages and schematics, as long as they aren't magically altered. The wizard can't cast it on themselves. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
